source.label: Dota 2 live-client and OpenDota localization audit

upgrades.effect: After using a mobility spell, the next attack within five seconds burns extra maximum mana and temporarily prevents mana gain.
The passive counter loses its cooldown, advances on the caster's own attacks, and applies stacking outgoing attack-damage reduction.
Creates two fragile, uncontrollable illusions that channel the same disable. Their damage does not stack.
Slides in a direction, leaving a projectile-disjointing clone that shatters into an area disable when damaged or timed out.
Creates an icy hill that knocks enemies away and grants high-ground bonuses, flying vision, and extra ranged attack range.
Casting another ability releases a shorter stun along an existing terrain barrier.
The projectile calls down additional area damage along its flight path and a weaker second burst on impact.
Creates a strong illusion of a target hero that can cast basic abilities; recasting swaps the caster into its position.
The expanding ultimate returns to its caster, healing for all damage dealt on the way back.
Activating an illusion passive makes the caster invisible, grants movement speed, and leaves a duplicate image behind.
All tethered enemies are attacked at 90% of the caster's attack rate, including while stunned after breaking the tether.
The hook deals bonus damage based on enemy pull distance, while hooking an ally halves its cooldown.
The storm strikes two targets at once and can damage towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
Activating the attack passive grants the caster and nearby allies three empowered attacks plus bonus attack speed.
The projectile gains cast range and a basic dispel; alt-cast adds damage and carries the caster alongside it.
Channels to hurl nearby trees toward an area, applying the caster's attacks and tree-throw bonuses.
Death creates a full-damage spell-casting illusion; respawning while it survives moves the hero to the illusion.
Creates a vector-targeted wind that pushes every enemy in its area toward the chosen direction.
Creates a global-range storm cloud that repeatedly casts a lightning spell on nearby enemies.
The ultimate summons two ships in sequence, each firing cannonball waves from both sides for partial damage.
Grants unobstructed movement, spell amplification, magic resistance, and maximum stacks of an attack-speed passive.
The channel affects two additional enemies, gains break distance, and grants debuff immunity with magic resistance.
The channel can target allies and friendly wards; affected units repeatedly emit radial damage around themselves.
Attaches a heavy anchor that leashes an enemy; four hero attacks destroy it.
Temporarily transforms the caster into a hidden, slower-attacking version of their own summoned ward.
The channel becomes area-targeted and allows its caster to use other abilities while channeling.
The caster can hide inside an ally during the attack sequence, granting that ally movement speed and extending the effect.
Every stun pulse creates an uncontrollable summoned unit beside the target and lasts slightly longer.
Teleports an enemy farther away, then roots them and temporarily reduces both attack and cast range.
Launches an area grenade that damages and disarms enemies while knocking both them and the caster backward.
Transforms the caster into a traveling healing-and-damage pulse that spreads to nearby units after reaching its target.
Nearby controlled-unit attacks accelerate repeating drumbeats that damage enemies and heal the caster's army.
Blinking creates damaging, silencing bursts at both the departure and arrival points.
The infection lowers magic resistance, spreads with full impact damage from hero targets, and has a much shorter cooldown.
For 1.5 seconds after landing a mobility spell, recast it to return to the previous location without reverting health.
Spells and attacks send an extra spirit through the target, dealing bonus damage before returning with healing.
Releases blades in every direction, damaging enemies by maximum health and applying Break.
Channeling through the caster's ward refracts the effect to every enemy hero nearby at reduced strength.
Slams into an area, creates a damaging zone, and applies a defensive poison passive to nearby enemies.
The ultimate can follow an allied target or affect an area, while producing more beams without a per-unit limit.
Ignites a ground area, dealing lingering damage over time; its cast range is shorter while the caster is melee.
The bouncing heal can target enemies, damaging them, healing nearby allies, and triggering an attack against each enemy bounce.
Grants flying movement, flying vision, and speed but prevents attacking and severely limits turning.
Turns the caster and nearby enemies ethereal, slowing enemies and amplifying their incoming magic damage without penalizing the caster.
Curses all nearby enemy heroes, revealing them through fog and scaling damage and slow with surrounding trees.
Can enter an enemy hero, attacking from inside while gaining increased regeneration.
Affected allies leave a seven-second damaging trail that slows enemies; alt-cast disables the trail.
Channels a volley of piercing arrows that apply attack modifiers and a percentage of the caster's attack damage.
Repeats the targeted heal after three seconds at 65% effectiveness.
Roots one enemy and compels every nearby creep—friendly, hostile, or neutral—to attack it with bonus speed.
Pay health to apply a basic self-dispel, then heal for the health spent plus a bonus for every debuff removed.
Killing an enemy hero refreshes every basic ability; the associated passive also grants more movement and attack speed.
Places invisible web-line traps connected to existing webs; crossing heroes are rooted, revealed, and damaged over time.
Applies the caster's invisibility buff and all its bonuses to an ally without breaking the caster's own invisibility.
Enemies crossed during the movement spell are marked, then struck by a secondary attack when the caster exits.
The ground fire lasts longer, deals pure damage, and gains ice walls that heavily slow enemies crossing its edges.
The tether grabs its target and that target's nearest allied hero, linking the second victim to the first.
The global heal becomes channeled; nearby allies gain debuff immunity, magic resistance, and stronger healing over time.
The ultimate applies Break and also affects enemies near its target; self-cast instead affects enemies around the caster.
Redirects enemy unit-targeted spells aimed near a chosen hero onto the caster while granting magic resistance.
The tracking projectile continuously fires the caster's close-range barrage around itself after a short delay.
Throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel plus attack speed, movement speed, and health regeneration.
Turns a wall spell into a vector-targeted strip that roots enemies who remain inside long enough.
Prevents lethal-threshold damage, strongly dispels the caster, and grants an undispellable mana-based barrier on a long internal cooldown.
Bites an allied hero, granting transformation properties and shared lifesteal healing while the two remain near each other.
Continuously removes negative effects from an ally, then heals them when the duration ends.
Creating an illusion has a chance to create another; activating the ultimate also creates global illusions of allied heroes.
Burrows underground, becoming invulnerable and untargetable while restoring 25% maximum health over three seconds.
Enchants a tree with long-lasting, invisible, unobstructed vision until the tree or hidden eye is destroyed.
Shields an ally from several hero attacks and launches a fireball back whenever damage is absorbed; towers are valid targets.
Allows an allied hero to hide inside the summoned structure, with restrictions and a stun if the structure is destroyed.
Can hold two stolen spells at once, extends cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their enhanced versions.
Creates a kinetic wall after a short formation delay that enemies cannot cross.
Burrows in place, becoming invisible and unable to attack while gaining damage reduction and empowering several other abilities.
The projectile gains range and speed, pierces debuff immunity, and applies Break.
Summons a flickering light that alternates on and off, repeatedly drawing nearby enemies toward it.
Continuously spawns orbiting orbs that slow enemy heroes on collision and can be detonated manually.
Activating the defensive passive causes an invulnerable stone form that stuns nearby enemies and restores health.
Creates a cloud that hides all allies inside and grants them the effects of the hero's defensive ultimate.
When targeted by a spell, fires a single-target projectile back at the caster that briefly turns them to stone.
Sweeping lights reveal invisible enemies, make attacks miss, and rapidly drain the maximum health of illusions caught in the beams.
After ricocheting, the projectile expands, pierces enemy heroes, and fears them while dealing increased damage.
A successful parry creates a stronger mark that adds stun duration and critical damage.
Giving a unit-targeted buff to an ally also buffs the caster; self-casts copy to the nearest allied hero.
